mapper.select: SELECT FROM sensitive_word WHERE region = #{region} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT word FROM sensitive_word WHERE region = #{region} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY LENGTH(word) DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sensitive_word(region, word, match_mode, enabled, remark) VALUES (#{region}, #{word}, #{matchMode}, #{enabled}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sensitive_word SET word = #{word}, match_mode = #{matchMode}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND region = #{region}
